messages:
emma: Flagging Greenfield Labs - ACH setup failing during microdeposit verification. Attempted setup for acct ending 6789. Bank returned code ACH-R01 on initial debit. Customer says bank is 'CoastalTrust Canada' but account is USD.
payments-bot: ACH_SETUP_FAILED customer=greenfield-labs attempt=1 error=R01_insufficient_funds bank=coastaltrust-ca
lucas: Looking. R01 typically insufficient funds; but microdeposits should still post. Is this InstantVerify via Plaid or standard microdeposits?
emma: Support ticket #S-9420: customer used our instant verify flow but Plaid returned 'account_type_mismatch' (business vs consumer). They manually uploaded routing/account.
lucas: Two failure vectors: 1) Plaid instant verify declined -> we shouldn't create token; 2) If token created and debit attempted, bank returned R01. Ops: pause retries and don't escalate to collections yet.
priya: Finance: amount on invoice inv_2026_0701 is $2,100. We can allow up to 3 manual ACH retries before suggesting wire for speed. For >$5k we'd require prefunding or wire.
emma: I've emailed customer asking to (1) confirm account type + upload a voided check, (2) try Instant Verify again with business account or switch to card. Ticket linked: https://zendesk.redwood/s/9420
lucas: For retries: set invoice.metadata.retry_policy=\"3-manual-ach\" and status to \"pending_payment_verification\". If Plaid returns account_type_mismatch, fall back to microdeposit flow and pause auto-retries.
payments-bot: Action logged: set invoice inv_2026_0701 hold_reason=bank_verification_pending
priya: If customer needs faster resolution, finance can pre-approve a one-off wire. Emma, ask customer if they'd like wire instructions; include vendor form for us to collect payee details.
emma: Done. Offered wire and card option. Awaiting customer preference.
lucas: If customer supplies voided check, ops can run a safe small debit of $1 to verify routing before full debit. Use command below (ops token required):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/verify-bank \ 
  -d '{\"customer_id\":\"greenfield-labs\",\"account_last4\":\"6789\",\"amount_cents\":100}' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
priya: Noting for reconciliation: mark attempts and don't recognize revenue until payment settled. Keep finance looped.
emma: Will update ticket and follow up in 6 hours.
